//: Shared button class recipe — the single styling source for BOTH stacks.
//rules: Encodes CURRENT production styling (indigo primary, rounded-md). Do not restyle here without a design decision.
Variant strings carry their own font/shadow so non-solid variants (ghost) can differ without class-order conflicts.
disabled strings deliberately contain no hover: classes (see .claude/guidelines/ui-patterns.md disabled rule).

Cursor behavior is stack-specific and intentionally NOT in this file: HEEx adds disabled:cursor-auto, React adds disabled:cursor-not-allowed (pre-existing divergence, logged in ../docs/poc/button-risk-log.md).
base: rounded-md text-sm phx-submit-loading:opacity-75 justify-center flex flex-row

primary.enabled: font-semibold shadow-xs bg-primary-600 hover:bg-primary-500 text-white focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-primary-600

secondary.enabled: font-semibold shadow-xs bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-900 ring-1 ring-gray-300 ring-inset
secondary.disabled: font-semibold shadow-xs bg-gray-50 text-gray-400 ring-1 ring-gray-200 ring-inset

danger.enabled: font-semibold shadow-xs bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-red-600

success.enabled: font-semibold shadow-xs bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-green-600

warning.enabled: font-semibold shadow-xs bg-yellow-600 hover:bg-yellow-500 text-white focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-yellow-600

ghost.enabled: font-semibold bg-transparent text-gray-900 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-gray-400
